summary: Transcendence in unbendable independence depends upon mendable ascendance into resplendence of endless splendor as candles cast shadows against against a dying light #smallpoems #lra2020 Day 2 reflection
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Transcendence
  in unbendable
independence
  depends upon
mendable
   ascendance
into resplendence
  of endless
splendor as
candles cast
  shadows against
against a dying light
